items.summary: On Friday evening Beijing time the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released a labour market report far weaker than the market had expected.
items.summary_zh: 北京时间周五晚间，美国劳工统计局披露了一份令市场大呼意外的疲软就业市场报告
